Camino in NYC

Camino is the gummy line from Kiva Confections, the California edibles company, produced under license in New York. It is one of the most widely stocked edible brands in the city, carried at 59 of the 67 licensed dispensaries we track with about 595 products, every one of them an edible. The line is organized by intended effect, with names like Balance, Bliss, Energy and Sleep, and each is a 10- or 20-count tin of flavored gummies or chews.

Prices start at $20.80, with most tins between $28 and $34 before tax, so Camino is a mid-priced option rather than an entry-level one. The deepest selections are at The Travel Agency Downtown Brooklyn with 20 products, and Culture House in Midtown and The Flowery Upper West Side with 19 each, followed by The Travel Agency SoHo, PRYZM and NY Canna Co. Because Camino is so widely carried, it is a useful price comparison: the same tin can vary by several dollars across shops a few blocks apart.

Camino FAQ
What is the difference between Camino gummies and chews?

Gummies are the standard fruit-flavored line, usually 5 milligrams per piece in a 20-count tin. Chews are the softer, often higher-dose format, around 10 milligrams per piece in a 10-count tin. Both are labeled by effect.

Does Camino make a low-THC option?

Yes. The Balance line is a 1:1 ratio of THC to CBD at 5 milligrams each per piece, and Camino also makes ratios with CBN for sleep and THCV for energy. Check the ratio on the tin.

Why does the same Camino tin cost different amounts at different shops?

Each licensed dispensary sets its own prices. In our data, Camino tins range from about $28 to $37 for comparable products depending on the store. Sensei shows the pre-tax menu price at every shop so you can compare.
